meta.option: Option A — one-tap snooze to tomorrow
meta.author: Design QA sample — fictional product 'Fieldbook', for illustrating the report format only
meta.boundary: Snooze from the task list and task detail, offline, Spanish. Excludes desktop and recurring tasks. Everything in this sample is invented to show the format.

verdict.headline: Snoozing works online, but offline snoozes look confirmed when they are only queued, and supervisors can't see why work moved.
verdict.summary: The one-tap path is fast and clear in both themes. Two P1 gaps: offline confirmation overstates what happened, and the supervisor's view loses the reason for a snooze. Decide the reason rule before build.
verdict.user_value_note: Technicians report deferring work they can't finish (E01), but no analytics show how often (E03). Validate with a measurement of snooze → completion within 48 h.

intent.problem: Technicians can't finish some tasks on the day (no parts, no access) and the task stays overdue, hiding real problems.
intent.users: Field technicians (primary); supervisors who plan the next day (secondary).
intent.job: Move a task I can't do today to a sensible later time, without losing why.
success: Task moves to the chosen time and leaves today's overdue list
Supervisor can see that it was snoozed and why
intent.outcome_chain: Can't finish on site → snooze with a reason → task reappears when it can be done → supervisor plans around it → fewer stale overdue tasks

evidence.claim: Technicians often lack parts or access and defer work informally
Supervisors plan the next day from overdue and snoozed work
No event exists yet for deferral; overdue count is the only proxy
evidence.source: Analytics saved insight 'Overdue tasks per day'

evidence.claim: Basements and plant rooms frequently have no signal

findings.title: Offline snoozes look confirmed when they're only queued
findings.expected: A clear 'saved on phone, will send when online' state that persists until sync.
findings.actual: Same success toast and list state as online; spec doesn't mention offline.
findings.why: Technician leaves believing the supervisor sees it; supervisor plans around stale data. Frequency unknown, but no-signal rooms are common (E04).

action.recommendation: Add an offline variant of the toast and a pending marker on the task until sync; reuse the app's existing offline banner.

findings.retest: S02: snooze offline → see pending marker → reconnect → marker clears and supervisor view updates.

findings.title: Supervisors lose the reason and history of snoozes
findings.expected: Supervisors can see why a task moved and whether it keeps moving.
findings.actual: Reason is optional and device-local; each snooze overwrites the last.
findings.why: Snooze can hide exactly the stale work the feature was meant to surface (intent: problem).

action.recommendation: Decide how much reason capture to require before build. Recommend B if supervisors confirm they plan from reasons.

options.label: B — Required quick reason chips (No parts / No access / Other)
C — No reason; show snooze count and history only
options.tradeoff: Zero friction; supervisor sees pattern but not cause.

findings.retest: S03 and S06 with the chosen option.

findings.title: Spanish snooze label truncates
findings.expected: Full label readable, or a shorter translation.
findings.why: Minor, but hides which time is being chosen.

action.recommendation: Let the button wrap to two lines or use the shorter string 'Posponer a mañana'.

findings.retest: S05 in Spanish at default and large text size.
